facts.fact: 章首雪洞：Gerrick 侦察归来报怪物数以百计千计——Vasara 正在组建军队
预嘱：若他倒下她必须逃——弃目标必要时逃 Sarkovian 山脉；她拒绝"我们一起"
facts.anchor: “If I fall, you must run. Abandon the goal, and get out of the Northeastern Shores. Flee to the Sarkovian Mountains

facts.fact: 身世确认：光女巫 Cecilia 之女、能根除黑魔法的继承人——不能丢下四人
facts.anchor: She was Cecilia the Light Witch’s daughter, the light heir containing the ability to eradicate dark magic

facts.fact: 侦察：上千怪物数百黑帐篷训练场拖尸——Vasara 宅邸实为要塞（灰石铁门四角塔楼）
facts.anchor: Gerrick was right. There had to be a thousand monsters here.

facts.fact: 调虎离山：火焰化身魔性女子在营地北端纵火抓怪抛下——朋友们的手笔；她清晨溜走独自冲下山
facts.anchor: The flaming form of a demonic woman rose high over the encampment

facts.fact: 落单兽人偷袭：肩抓腿钉——她拔刀刺穿喉咙反杀黑血溅面
facts.anchor: shoving the blade through the center of its throat with a sickening crunch. Black blood rained down onto Andra’s face

facts.fact: 繁殖营：暗帐锁链裸女腹部隆起黑线蠕动——她问"你怀孕了吗"对方点头；走廊全是同样女人
facts.anchor: An enormous growth extended from her abdomen where black lines writhed along her skin, pulsing with each internal beat.

facts.fact: 链条会报警无法解救——承诺"我会回来救你们所有人"；退出后帐内惨叫骤止闷响
facts.anchor: “I’ll come back for you,” she whispered, guilt curling in her gut as she backed toward the tent flaps. “For all of you.”

facts.fact: 风暴解放：悲怒之下魔法撕开——风与电卷起怪物杂物冲天旋风；Gerrick 喊"把它收回来"以心跳口诀助收
facts.anchor: Magic tore from her body, her skin the catalyst for the winds surrounding the entirety of the camp

facts.fact: 章末转折：风停后长矛天降贯穿 Gerrick 后背尖端穿出前胸——他跪倒她抱进怀里
facts.anchor: A spear fell through the sky and stabbed through Gerrick’s back, the point protruding from his chest.

facts.fact: 遗言："我说过我会永远追随你""直到我最后一口气"——微笑闭眼生死未卜
facts.anchor: She looked at his face, his expression gentle as his head grew heavier in her lap.
